data.exact_reserve_text: The board of Markettorm Managing Agency Limited (MMA) resolved to leave the 2007 year of account open due to the continuing uncertainty of the Italian Public Hospitals Medical Malpractice reserves. The Syndicate ceased underwriting this business from the 2008 year of account. The settlement of these claims continues to be managed actively and the number of open claims on this account has reduced from 1,488 at December 2013 to 964 at December 2014. The current net reserve held against IPH is GBP 104.6m (2013: GBP 127.0m). The board of MMA resolved to close the 2012 year of account at a loss of GBP 6.3m.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Continuing uncertainty on ultimate cost; number of open claims reduced from 1,488 at Dec 2013 to 964 at Dec 2014; net reserve reduced from GBP 127.0m to GBP 104.6m (net figure shown).
2012 year of account was closed at a loss of GBP 6.3m.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 was GBP 581.108m. The report does not provide a consolidated gross prior-year reserve movement figure in the technical reserves notes; narrative highlights both adverse developments (notably deteriorations in Dutch hospital medical malpractice, Australian binder general liability and sports sector personal accident) and movements in reinsurance recoverables, alongside a reduction in the net reserve for Italian Public Hospitals (from GBP 127.0m to GBP 104.6m). The 2012 year of account was closed at a loss of GBP 6.3m. Overall the document describes mixed prior-year experience with specific adverse developments in several liability lines and some favourable movement on the Italian Public Hospitals exposure (net basis).
